name: Boatyard Pub
bio: The Boatyard Pub is a seafood pub and restaurant at Ventura Harbor, with local craft beers on tap and a patio overlooking the harbor. It hosts live music most days of the week.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from boatyardpub.com and @boatyardpub.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
